name: São Tomé and Príncipe
build: Constitution: six historical versions (1975-2003). 133 acts from Diário da República editions (2003–2026), dated by entry into force where the act states it, otherwise by publication day; codes: Road Code, Court Costs Code, Family Code, Notarial Code, Commercial Registry Code, Land Registry Code, Labour Code, Penal Code. Later amendments not applied.
